reason: A multi-module DSH plugin primarily focused on persistent browser and repository workflow automation, with MCP exposure, GitHub/GitLab webhook integrations, automated reviews, and optional issue-fix execution.

summaries.zh: 面向 DSH 的自动化插件套件，提供共享浏览器控制、MCP 服务以及 GitHub 和 GitLab 评审与问题修复工作流集成。
summaries.en: An automation suite for DSH that provides shared browser control, an MCP server, and GitHub and GitLab review and issue-fixing workflow integrations.

capabilities: Automates browser sessions including navigation, form input, file upload and download, JavaScript evaluation, cookies, and persistent profiles
Exposes local DSH sessions and agent execution through an MCP HTTP server with bearer-token or OAuth authentication
Integrates with GitHub and GitLab APIs and webhooks for pull or merge request reviews
Can automatically create local issue-fix branches, run tests, push changes, and open pull requests when configured
Injects an in-app status and configuration panel
